design.studyScope: prompt decomposition versus distributed structure under equal visible-call budgets

preflight.zeroCompletionPolicy: stop before main batch; round 11 closes this research line regardless of outcome
preflight.adjustmentPolicy: No outcome-dependent task, budget, arm or seed changes; no twelfth round.

design.executionOrder: sequential paired seed blocks; rotate arm order by seed; no outcome-dependent retries
design.seedMeaning: fixture seed, not a provider sampling seed; stochastic model sampling is not controlled
design.rationale: Sixteen ledger shards with 10 orders each, fourteen paired seeds and 512 visible model calls per arm. The added single-scaffolded control differs from single only by its appended per-shard decomposition instruction. This final round isolates the previously confounded prompt structure comparison; truncation, headroom and audit gaps remain reported observations.
design.documentAccess: identical public index and read_document access; no topology binding; forwarding permitted
design.independentPool: 15 independent candidates each assigned one of shards 1..15; the 32-step synthesis entry owns shard 16 and merges all candidates; no peer communication, no oracle selection; all 16 allocations count

statistics.correctness: Wilson 95%; paired Tango score 95% and exact McNemar; Holm across ten pairs
statistics.continuous: median, linear-interpolated Q1/Q3, distribution-free order-statistic 95% median CI; paired median differences and sign tests, Holm across ten pairs per metric
statistics.unknownUsage: null remains unknown; report known lower bounds and coverage separately
statistics.workloadGate: Only two live feasibility gates: at least one exact completion; every attempted preflight run has positive integer issuedModelCalls equal to metrics.totals.attempts. Truncation, output headroom and audit gaps are report-only. Zero-call attempts remain in the denominator and are infrastructure evidence, not model reasoning failures.
statistics.power: n=14 is the brief minimum, not a guarantee of statistical power or equivalence

design.failurePolicy: Every started attempt is retained, including timeout, exception, interruption, wrong answer and unknown usage. Never replace a failed sample.

scaffoldPrompt.instruction:
Required solving procedure: process the shards sequentially, one shard per model call. Do not try to calculate all shards in a single call.
Read the shared policy and the current shard documents with read_document. Compute that shard and record a concise intermediate result in your conversation: its shard id and all four netByAccount balances. Preserve the accumulated intermediate results as you proceed to the next shard.
Use the existing read_document tool to request the next shard documents and continue across calls. Intermediate results are working notes, not the final answer; do not finish while any shard remains unprocessed.
After every shard has an intermediate result, check that every shard occurs exactly once, merge the accumulated balances, and submit the one final JSON object in the required answer format.
